xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4506: Review kickoff rejected by Herdr ('unexpected end of hex escape at column 4021'): reviewer never starts, stall detector re-dispatches forever

plan.title: Review kickoff rejected by Herdr ('unexpected end of hex escape at column 4021'): reviewer never starts, stall detector re-dispatches forever
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every PAN-4383 review kickoff is rejected by Herdr with 'invalid_request: unexpected end of hex escape'. Root cause (verified): review-context.ts:460 truncates CodeRabbit finding bodies with .slice(0, 200), which splits an emoji and leaves a lone high surrogate (\ud83e) in the tier-1 summary embedded in the kickoff; JSON.stringify emits it as a lone \ud83e escape that Herdr's serde_json rejects (reproduced live with a read-only agent.get). spawnRun discards the ok:false kickoff result for non-kimi harnesses, so the reviewer sits idle, silent-reviewer recovery re-dispatches the same doomed text, and every new review request repeats the cycle.
narratives.Proposal: Fix the truncation code-point-safely (new leaf helper src/lib/well-formed-text.ts), sanitize every Herdr request and the paste-submit path as a backstop, make spawnRun fail (close pane, stop agent, throw KickoffRejectedError) when the kickoff fails with invalid_request, and have spawnReviewRoleForIssue journal a new review.dispatch-failed entry plus a Needs-you activity entry so deacon-lite recovery stops re-dispatching it. Document the new journal type and the Herdr wire rule.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not modify src/lib/agents/delivery.ts (1 line of file-size headroom); the resume retry loop still tries twice on invalid_request
- Do not modify src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr.ts (at its 1008-line cap)
- Do not fail the spawn on other ok:false kickoff failures (ambiguous disconnects, guard refusals, tmux failures)
- Do not wire journal tails into the Command Deck Needs-you bucket (derived-issue-state attention)
- Do not add permanent request-byte logging for Herdr invalid_request errors
- Do not bump tsconfig lib to ES2024 or use String.prototype.toWellFormed
- Do not file a Herdr upstream issue (its rejection is correct serde_json behavior)
- Do not touch PAN-4383's workspace or re-request its review (operator step after deploy)
- Do not audit or rewrite every other .slice(0, n) in src/lib
- Do not raise any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap

autoDecisions.summary: Fix at the source (review-context truncation) and sanitize at the Herdr wire (herdr-api.ts replacer + herdr-submit).
autoDecisions.rationale: The source fix removes this failure; the wire sanitization guarantees no other truncated string anywhere can wedge a Herdr request again, at the cost of one U+FFFD character.

autoDecisions.summary: Herdr is not at fault; no upstream issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reproduced: serde_json rejects a lone surrogate escape when deserializing a String; the client must send well-formed UTF-16.

autoDecisions.summary: Only an 'invalid_request:' kickoff failure fails spawnRun; other ok:false failures keep today's behavior.
autoDecisions.rationale: invalid_request means Herdr executed nothing and a retry of the same text fails identically; other failures (e.g. an ambiguous disconnect after pane.send_text was written) may have typed the text, so failing the spawn could kill a working reviewer.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs-you is surfaced through surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou (activity entry), the channel PAN-4433's silent-reviewer escalation already uses.
autoDecisions.rationale: The Command Deck Needs-you bucket derives only from a blocked pane; extending derived attention is a separate, larger change.

autoDecisions.summary: A new journal type review.dispatch-failed ends the recovery loops by becoming the journal tail.
autoDecisions.rationale: recoverUndispatchedReviews acts only on a request-review verification.passed tail and stalledReviewReason only on review.requested/dispatched/redispatched, so the new tail is skipped with no routine change; W7 pins it with tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Issue fix step 1 (capture the rejected request bytes) was completed during planning instead of adding permanent logging.
autoDecisions.rationale: The probe of the real PAN-4383 manifest found the lone surrogate at the 200-char cut of CodeRabbit finding 0, and a live read-only Herdr probe reproduced the exact error.

autoDecisions.summary: PAN-4383 recovery is an operator/Flywheel step after deploy (pan review request PAN-4383).
autoDecisions.rationale: The work agent cannot deploy; the AC's 'test reproducing its text' is covered by W2 and W3 tests using the PAN-4383 pattern.

items.title: Add the well-formed UTF-16 text helper module

narrative.Action: PRD W1. Create src/lib/well-formed-text.ts (no imports) exporting toWellFormedText(text) (replace every lone surrogate with U+FFFD using the regex /[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])|(?<![\uD800-\uDBFF])[\uDC00-\uDFFF]/g, no u flag) and truncateWellFormed(text, maxUnits) (slice, then drop a trailing high surrogate). Do not use String.prototype.toWellFormed (untyped under the ES2022 lib). Write the unit tests listed in the PRD.

items.title: Given 'a\uD83Eb', when toWellFormedText runs, then it returns 'a\uFFFDb'; given 'ok 🛠️' it returns the input unchanged

narrative.Action: PRD W3. In herdr-api.ts add a module-level wellFormedReplacer (strings -> toWellFormedText) and pass it to JSON.stringify at BOTH write sites (`call` and `stream`). In herdr-submit.ts pasteAndSubmitHerdrPane, rename the text parameter to rawText and make `const text = toWellFormedText(rawText);` the first statement so pane.send_text and screenComposerPayloadPresence see the same string. Do NOT edit herdr.ts (at its 1008-line cap). New test file uses a fake HerdrSocket via HerdrApiClient({ connect }) and a fake api for pasteAndSubmitHerdrPane with injected sleep/now; no real sockets or timers. Assert absence of lone surrogates by regex — Node's JSON.parse accepts them, so 'it parses' proves nothing.
